scope: Austin prototype, fictional traffic, no turn-by-turn claim

checks.name: Install and launch
checks.procedure: Install the new debug APK, open AeroDrive, and confirm there is no launch crash. Record the APK hash and phone Android version.

checks.name: Default simulation
checks.procedure: Start without the bridge or credentials. Confirm fictional traffic is the default and is visibly labeled SIMULATED.

checks.name: Street map and attribution
checks.procedure: Confirm the Austin street map renders and its required attribution remains readable and reachable.

checks.name: Offline test map
checks.procedure: Select Test map, disconnect networking, and confirm the schematic and fictional aircraft remain usable. Do not call the schematic an offline road map.

checks.name: Network recovery
checks.procedure: Reconnect and select Street map. Confirm the hosted style reloads without an app reinstall.

checks.name: Map and aircraft controls
checks.procedure: Exercise zoom, recenter, nearest, show/hide, pause/resume, and reset. Record any control that does not behave as labeled.

checks.name: Traffic limits and reference origin
checks.procedure: Confirm no more than five aircraft appear. Verify the 25 NM boundary with fixtures and label distance as measured from the fixed Austin origin, not current GPS.

checks.name: Stale positions
checks.procedure: Run Stale test. Confirm expired positions disappear and can be restored. Do not infer freshness from the HTTP request time.

checks.name: Source-switch race
checks.procedure: Switch sources while a bridge request is pending. Confirm the old response cannot replace the newly selected source.

checks.name: Lifecycle and layout
checks.procedure: Check portrait, landscape, day/night, large text, system bars, background/resume, and process recreation. Keep an observation for each subcase.

checks.name: About and notices
checks.procedure: Open About and inspect license, attribution, and source links. Confirm no credentials are displayed or bundled.

checks.name: Launch and surface
checks.procedure: Open AeroDrive from Android Auto in the DHU. Confirm the real map surface appears rather than a blank surface or only a template.

checks.name: Map controls
checks.procedure: Check pan mode, zoom, recenter, and host-supported pinch. Record unsupported gestures instead of marking them passed.

checks.name: Touch and rotary
checks.procedure: Repeat key actions in touch and rotary profiles. Confirm focus is visible, stable, and recoverable with Back.

checks.name: Parked-only actions
checks.procedure: With restrict none, exercise Nearest and Show/Hide. With restrict all, attempt them again and confirm the host prevents their actions.

checks.name: Shared state
checks.procedure: While parked, change map, simulation, and source settings on the phone. Confirm the car receives the selected state.

checks.name: Day/night and attribution
checks.procedure: Run day and night. Confirm both the map and attribution remain readable and do not collide with host controls.

checks.name: Map safe areas
checks.procedure: Use standard and wide profiles. Check visible/stable area handling and confirm host panels do not hide required map content.

checks.name: Reconnect
checks.procedure: Disconnect and reconnect the DHU three times. Confirm there are no crashes, persistent blank surfaces, duplicate subscriptions, or stuck controls.

checks.name: Lifecycle resources
checks.procedure: Inspect logs and profiling while stopping the screen and destroying its surface. Confirm subscriptions stop and only app-owned rendering resources are released.

checks.name: Updates and focus
checks.procedure: Observe an active simulation for five minutes. Check template refresh behavior, UI focus, and responsiveness while aircraft positions update.

checks.name: Distance wording
checks.procedure: Confirm any displayed distance is a snapshot from the fixed Austin origin. No field should imply live GPS navigation or a real ETA.

checks.name: Overlay behavior while restricted
checks.procedure: Under restrict all, record whether aircraft remain visible, move, or can be selected. This is an observation for Google, not a policy pass for aircraft overlays.

checks.name: Fixture bridge
checks.procedure: Start the bridge in its documented default fixture mode, prepare the reverse tunnel, and select it on the phone.

checks.name: Source identification
checks.procedure: Confirm bridge fixtures cannot be mistaken for live OpenSky traffic.

checks.name: Bridge unavailable
checks.procedure: Stop the bridge. Confirm an error is visible while the map remains usable.

checks.name: Freshness expiry
checks.procedure: Leave the bridge unavailable past the documented freshness window. Confirm old aircraft disappear.

checks.name: Stale and empty fixtures
checks.procedure: Restart the bridge with its documented stale and empty scenarios. Record both outcomes.

checks.name: Cache and backoff
checks.procedure: Repeatedly switch simulation and bridge sources. Confirm this does not bypass cache or rate-limit backoff.

checks.name: Tunnel recovery
checks.procedure: Remove and recreate only the selected device's bridge tunnel. Confirm recovery without reinstalling the app.

note: A passed local checklist is not Google Play approval. A response may reject the feature.
